page.notes: The running head's section sign is printed in a worn form, so it is read as "§" with [?]. The printed "Jefuita" is read as "Iefuita" (I used for J), as in the other occurrences on the page. The final word "præ-" is broken at the line end and continues on the next page. The "ib. refpo." reference sits in the text line, not in a margin. Long s has been written as plain s throughout.
